query:
The Clay & Fire Collective operates on an apparent norm that work in progress is not photographed or shared without the maker's permission. Does this norm apply equally to all members?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Reuben
C. Simone
D. Yuki
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t6 @2026-04-12T10:37:00) I can take the photos for everyone if people want?? I've gotten pretty good at ceramics photography
[2] (about=Callum, episodic, t8 @2026-05-17T10:11:00) Yes, please do. That was actually on my list -- I wanted someone to photograph the full set laid out before I pack them. Make sure you get the rim detail in natural light if you can. The translucency only shows properly in daylight.
[3] (about=Callum, said_by=Simone, profile, t8 @2026-05-17T09:38:00) Simone wants to photograph Callum's plate set for a proper record before they go to Portugal.
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-15T10:42:00) okay so here's the thing, I've been thinking about doing a group critique session properly in March -- not just a quick chat but a proper round of feedback. I'm wondering if we should do it as the main activity rather than alongside throwing. thoughts? I can set it up properly -- printed notes, the whole thing. 📋
[5] (about=Reuben, core, t12 @2026-07-19T09:49:00) Acknowledges it means another week's work but doing it wrong because it's faster produces mediocre work; process must be right before surface can be right.
[6] (about=Simone, core, t6 @2026-04-12T09:43:00) Has gotten good at ceramics photography; offers to take photos for group.
[7] (about=Simone, core, t8 @2026-05-17T09:38:00) Wants to photograph Callum's plate set for a proper record.
agent_answer:
Yes — the norm applies equally to all members. There is no evidence that any member is exempt.

- **Nadia**: No record suggests any exception; the norm applies to her like everyone else.
- **Reuben**: No record suggests any exception; the norm applies to him equally.
- **Simone**: She is the one offering to photograph others (“I can take the photos for everyone if people want”), so she still asks permission rather than bypassing the norm; her own work as a maker would also be covered.
- **Yuki**: There is no record of Yuki on this matter, but that does not make Yuki exempt — the norm applies to all members equally.

The conversation shows the norm being honored: Simone offers to photograph, and Callum explicitly gives permission for his plate set. No member is treated as an exception.
